video_title: Was Shaq being PETTY for his fall out with Nick Van Exel 👀

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on his falling out with Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: Everything to me, this is where I think it fell apart with me and Shaq

text_blocks.speaker: Nick Van Exel
text_blocks.text: Everything to me, this is where I think it fell apart with me and Shaq. Early in the season, he asked me to do a commercial. I'm like, 'Hell yeah, big fella, I got you.' Back then, I was smoking weed. I never smoked weed in my life in my rookie year, but I started smoking weed. When they got there, it was my fourth year, I was still on that weed. Big fella asked me to do a commercial early in the season, so I'm like, 'Yeah, let's do it.' Long story short, months go by. I think it was after the All-Star break, his people called me and were like, 'Yeah, y'all got to come do the commercial today.' I'm like, 'Huh? You know at the practice, this is winding down.' I'm getting to the crib, I ain't leaving the crib. I said, 'I can't make it.' I think they called Derek Fisher and he went and did it.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: I think I just heard so much about this, bro.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the 1-2-3 Cancun comment to teammates
quotes.excerpt: When we played Utah in the playoffs, we get down 3-0. Nobody winning 3-0.

text_blocks.speaker: Nick Van Exel
text_blocks.text: When we played Utah in the playoffs, we get down 3-0. Nobody winning 3-0. We see guys now, and we know they basically saying '1-2-3 Cancun' without saying '1-2-3 Cancun'. The body is saying it. I was the cat on the team that, when shit was fucked up, I'm calling the team meeting. Let's get together. Let's go out, let's do whatever. I was the dude that was doing this with the team. And I knew, you always got to have a scapegoat. So I was that scapegoat. When I said '1-2-3 Cancun', everybody was like, 'Oh, he don't want to.' No, motherfucker, I'm still hooping, but we ain't coming back. And Cancun is around the corner and it's off the chain. What the fuck we want to go back to Utah and lose 4-1? What the fuck?

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: That's a classic. That's a classic.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: They think they used that as a scapegoat.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on being traded to the Denver Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: I get traded for T-Loo to Denver. Now that was the only thing I was mad about.
quotes.quote: We talked to Jerry West, my agent, the week before the draft. He's like, 'No, we not trading him, he good.' Then the draft night, I get traded for T-Loo to Denver. Now that was the only thing I was mad about was the fact that you traded me to Denver. Denver was at the bottom of the barrel at that time. One of the worst teams in the league. Won like 15 games the year before. I'm like, 'Damn, you trade me to there?' But he did that because he didn't want me to ball out like if I was to come back and play them in the playoffs. So Jerry West, I was mad a long motherfucking time.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the transition from championship contender to rebuilding
quotes.excerpt: It's like when you go from the championship vibe and then you go to a rebuilding process.
quotes.quote: It's like when you go from the championship vibe and then you go to a rebuilding process. That shit different. I tell people all the time, it's two NBAs. It's that playoff NBA and it's that NBA where you packing your shit up ready to go home after the All-Star break. That packing your shit up after the All-Star break, you don't even want to go out to eat. You can't wait till you get on the road to have that. You don't want to go out to eat, you just want to sit in the crib.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the Denver Nuggets roster talent
quotes.excerpt: We had a revolving door of good players. Once we traded up, we got McDyess.

text_blocks.speaker: Nick Van Exel
text_blocks.text: We had a revolving door of good players. Once we traded up, we got McDyess, which was great force. And then it was Dice, KG, Raef, and Chris Webber and Tim Duncan. Like them five, anytime they locked in them power fours, it was going at it. It was going at it.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: But did you ever get a chance to get the early McDyess?

text_blocks.speaker: Nick Van Exel
text_blocks.text: Hell yeah, that was a motherfucker. Dude would just jump out of the gym. Mid-range, one of them guys, for real.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Jump out the gym. Shout out to McDyess.
